Coach

Muay Thai Coach Tina

Competition Experience

Amateur fights: 3 Semi-Contact Matches (MDL/PKB): 15

Coaching Experience

5+ years of Muay Thai coaching at CMA Assistant coach of beginners program and entry level competition team

Tina discovered Muay Thai at 29 while living in New Zealand, and quickly became passionate about the sport, training six days a week and participating in her first fight within a year. Her journey in Muay Thai, transcending her experiences in running, team sports, and rock climbing, significantly boosted her overall fitness, confidence, and self-imposed physical boundaries. This practice not only enhanced her body awareness and strength but also deepened her appreciation for the community, skill, dedication, and the art of Muay Thai itself. Along her journey, Tina formed some of her most meaningful relationships and personal accomplishments. As a lifelong practitioner, she is committed to sharing the beauty and benefits of Muay Thai with people from diverse backgrounds.
